descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have a track record of successfully managing client relationships? Do you have innovative ideas to help us maintain and expand our client mandates?
We’re looking for a client relationship manager to:
• perform independently as all rounded, seasoned,
client oriented asset management sales
professionals
• proactively widen and deepen client and
prospective client relationships
• develop effective business strategies and actions
plans to maximize business results
• provide high-quality investment solutions,
working closely with other team members
• create strategic client book development plan
with measurable actions
• guard against exposure to operations risk
